text:
mike (AE): Heads-up  AstraMed requested a 3-week POC starting next Tuesday. They want a committed monthly figure, throughput sizing for ~11k peak rps with ~700 tokens avg, and explicit BYOK/HSM language in the contract.

sara (SE): They stressed predictable monthly spend. Finance says no to burst-only. Also asked for an AZ-eviction fallback and runbook.

diego (Solutions): Initial thumbprint: Dedicated in eu-west-1. For that workload profile recommend 5 reserved GPUs (A40-class equivalent) to cover steady 95th percentile, autoscale with headroom to 8 for bursts. If they opt into 8-bit quantization we can show a 1.6x throughput case which would allow 3-4 reserved GPUs instead.

mike (AE): Can we present three clean options for procurement: (A) 5 reserved baseline, (B) 8 reserved safety buffer, (C) 3 reserved + burst credits? Need monthly $ and a line about p99 risk.

diego (Solutions): Rough bullets for the slide:
- Option A (5 reserved): predictable cost, p99 within SLOs, minimal queuing.
- Option B (8 reserved): ~+55% cost, reduces queuing on sustained spikes, recommended for heavy tail workloads.
- Option C (3 reserved + burst): ~-20% cost vs A but higher p99 risk and possible request queuing under sustained surges.
I'll produce exact numbers in the ticket.

anya (Security): From their questionnaire: customer-managed keys required, HSM wrapping requested, SOC2 evidence, and 12-month audit log retention. Hosted vs Dedicated differences matter: Hosted default logs 90d, Dedicated + compliance pack supports 12mo.

sara (SE): For AZ eviction fallback we should recommend cross-AZ standby pool + graceful degradation to a smaller model variant if capacity constrained. Include KV-cache warmup and route-failover play.

diego (Solutions): Ops config suggestion:
```yaml
autoscale:
  min_replicas: 5
  max_replicas: 8
  target_gpu_utilization: 0.65
  cooldown_seconds: 120
prewarm:
  kv_warmup: true
  concurrency: 12
  ramp_seconds: 900
```
Smoke test: synthetic ramp 0->11000 rps over 15m, capture p50/p95/p99 and token_cost.csv per model variant. Example command: ```bash
loadgen --target 11000 --ramp 900 --payload=chat_700.json --capture=p99 --report=token_cost.csv
```

mike (AE): Legal will want HSM/BYOK addendum + liability language. I'll forward questionnaire and ask for the HSM addendum template.

anya (Security): Note: partner HSM/BYOK is supported as an enterprise add-on; FIPS-level HSMs require procurement and legal signoff. I'll draft the security responses and attach SOC2/ISO docs.

infra_bot: created ticket SRV-11258 "AstraMed POC: reserved plan + HSM addendum" assigned to diego, due 2026-04-06. :white_check_mark:

sara (SE): diego, please include cost-per-1k-responses at 512/700 tokens for both quantized and FP16 runtimes, and call out the financial impact of choosing Dedicated vs Hosted with compliance pack.

diego (Solutions): will add a small appendix showing quantized multipliers (q8 x1.6, q4 x1.3) and a per-1k-response cost table. Also will include a short AZ-failover runbook and the KV warmup script.

mike (AE): Timeline: questionnaire answers by Fri EOD, pricing deck + three options by Mon, infra and smoke test Tue. Can team deliver?

diego (Solutions): yes, will attach artifacts to SRV-11258.

anya (Security): ping me if you need key rotation logs or screenshots from our KMS integration. I'll include a note about key escrow policies when BYOK is used.

mike (AE): thanks all. I'll update AstraMed after we post the pricing deck. End of thread.
